## Selected Projects
- **OpenTelemetry Java SDK**: Contributor to CNCF. Bounded the JdkHttpSender thread pool to prevent unbounded thread creation and resource exhaustion. https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java/pull/8276
- **Presence Card**: Self-hosted presence card showing now-playing music and activity as an animated SVG for GitHub profile README. (Go, SVG)
- **GitGuide**: VS Code extension that reminds you to commit, suggests feature branches, and snapshots work in progress. (TypeScript)
- **Path2URL**: PHP library that converts relative file paths to absolute URLs in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- **FX-Deals**: Spring Boot service to import, validate, and persist FX deals with duplicate detection and bulk CSV ingest. (Java, PostgreSQL, Docker)
